title: I gave Astra 3 hours to make a game for Twitter
author: char-gen
selftext:
I gave it three hours to make a small browser game and this is what it came up with. It’s called LOAF and you stack sleeping cats until they fall over.



There was some back and forth on the physics. I also picked the music and meow, so there was a bit more input than just leaving it running for three hours.



You can play it here: [https://loaf-cat-stack.chargen.chatgpt.site/?seed=LAUNCH&target=5](https://loaf-cat-stack.chargen.chatgpt.site/?seed=LAUNCH&target=5)



Would like to hear what you think, especially if you have ideas for things to add.

replies.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
replies.body: Be respectful. Removed for AI Art or Artist bashing.

comments.author: HerbertGoon
comments.body: I gave Astra a prompt to fix a bug I couldn't find. It hit the 5 hour credit limit in the middle of its first action: zipping a backup of the build.

replies.author: 3dutchie3dprinting
replies.body:
I'm unaware how big your source code is but if you're asking it to find a bug in your entire repository the joke is on you ;-). It has to load/read/analyze (call it what you want) your entire code base in the hopes it will hit a point where you might have made a mistake and that's assuming it's purely a code issue.. When it's done with all the loading/reading/analyzing and it needs to actually test your application it burns hard.

A clear [agents.md](http://agents.md) file with some form of guidance is always a necessity, it can skip maybe 90% of your code if the bug is in the "user registration page" or maybe directly goes to visual testing, finding/seeing the error etc.

Unaware what your profession is but as a developer I've been asked to blindly assist in fixing "legacy code" where folders and filenames where not really properly applied and 90% of my personal "tokens"\* where burned trying to find the actual place things eventually went haywire, the fix itself was basically a 4 liner normalizing specific characters in the users emailaddress (the user put in françoise@mail.com).

  
\* time of course, just used tokens for the reference

replies.author: HerbertGoon
replies.body: I showed it the file to go to. don't create things in your head now. you just wasted all of that lol.
